items.name: The operator starts a run, and it performs the cycle's effects up to the gate's verdict
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: g/A: R-1 awaiting-verdicts; positions 1-9 stamp,pin,checklist,self-check,fence,regenerate,install,self-check,gate all recorded; gate events [regeneration-cycle/gate-attempt-passed]

items.name: A run identity is started once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: g/D: R-1 of C-1 failed at fence; start R-1 of C-2 refused run-already-started; run-progress lists R-1 once, cycle C-1

items.name: A second run is refused while the first awaits its verdicts
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: g/A: start R-2/C-2 while R-1 awaits refused run-in-progress; run-progress R-2 null; R-1 still awaiting-verdicts

items.name: A cycle is run once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: g/A: after R-1/C-1 passed, start R-2 of C-1 refused cycle-already-run; R-2 null

items.name: A run of something that is not a commit of the project repository is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: g/D: start R-4 at deadbeef... refused not-a-commit; R-4 null; builder launches stayed 0

items.name: A run whose context does not respond on its seam is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository, with its five contexts responding
items.evidence: g/R: measurement entrypoint exits at once; start refused contexts-not-responding, data.contexts [measurement]; R-1 null, runs []

items.name: Each handoff is handed in, unchanged and once, to every consumer, in its producer's order
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store
items.evidence: g/A: relayed: scenario-stamped pos1,pos2 ->measurement; source-cut-pinned pos1 ->measurement, ->regeneration-cycle; gate-attempt-passed pos1 ->measurement once; all accepted

items.name: A checklist Measurement refuses halts the run with Measurement's refusal
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store
items.evidence: g/D R-2: plan with no scenario; checklist refused empty-checklist (measurement); halted at checklist refused-before-the-cycle; effects only stamp,pin,checklist

items.name: A plan whose item identities a fresh stamp does not give back halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, and relays every handoff from its producer's store
items.evidence: g/D R-3: unstamped extra scenario; stamp recorded (01-001..003 vs plan 01-001,01-002); halted at stamp refused-before-the-cycle; no pin/checklist effect

items.name: A failing self-check fails the cycle at the fence, and the run with it
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: g/E R-1: self-check exit 1 last line 'golden checklist differs'; run failed, cycle failed fence/harness-self-check-failed detail 'golden checklist differs'; last effect self-check, no fence/regenerate

items.name: A check the self-check skips is recorded as a listed skip
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: g/E R-2: self-check printed 'SKIP bb-tools'; first self-check recorded harness-self-check-passed, skipped-checks [bb-tools], detail 'skipped checks: bb-tools'

items.name: A fenced path that matches nothing fails the cycle at the fence
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: g/D R-1: fence refused fenced-path-matched-nothing (regeneration-cycle); next effect fail-cycle recorded; failed at fence for fence-refused; 0 builder launches

items.name: The fresh builder sees the clean room of one commit with no fenced path
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: g/G13: builder room: 1 commit, 1 root, no remote, empty reflog; tree/rev-list --objects hold docs/plan, harness/config.sh, probe; no impl or harness/cycles path; impl empty

items.name: Each regenerate launches one builder and waits for it
items.rule: A regenerate launches one fresh builder and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: g/H: red then good; 2 launches (regenerate, repair); 2nd started 1.08s after 1st ended

items.name: A builder that exits non-zero but leaves a candidate is gated
items.rule: A regenerate launches one fresh builder and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: g/Q: builder exit 1 with a good candidate; regenerate recorded with that candidate's digest (log: 'exited 1; candidate sha256:1b5d...'); gate passed; R-1 awaiting-verdicts

items.name: A builder that leaves nothing fails the cycle at regenerate
items.rule: A regenerate launches one fresh builder and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: g/I: builder left impl empty; no regenerate effect; fail-cycle recorded; failed at regenerate for candidate-not-regenerated

items.name: A builder that outlives the regenerate timeout is stopped and the cycle fails for its budget
items.rule: A regenerate launches one fresh builder and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: g/J (rerun): regenerate timeout 2s, builder sleeps 30s; builder logged its start, never wrote its after-sleep file (checked 35s later) = stopped; failed at regenerate for budget

items.name: Something answering on the port is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: g/K: port held by grader; gate attempt 1 refused seam-answered-before-boot 3x, each followed by recorded gate-refusal; cycle failed gate/infrastructure; start.sh log empty (never started)

items.name: A red suite fails the attempt before the candidate is booted
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: g/L: red suite, limit 1; gate attempt 1 recorded gate-attempt-failed suite-red; app log shows test.sh only, start.sh never ran; failed at gate gate-attempts-exhausted

items.name: A candidate with no launch entrypoint fails the attempt for a missing contract
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: g/M: test.sh without start.sh, limit 1; gate attempt 1 recorded gate-attempt-failed contract-missing

items.name: A served page without the marker fails the attempt for its identity
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: g/N: page without sauna, limit 1; gate attempt 1 recorded gate-attempt-failed identity-probe-failed ('does not carry the marker sauna')

items.name: What a builder writes after it ended does not reach the gate
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: g/O (rerun): builder writer starts writing impl/red only after the builder process ended; gate room copy has no red, builder room has it; gate attempt 1 passed; install digest = regenerate digest (sha256:5e5e0f...)

items.name: A repair builder sees the previous candidate and the gate evidence, read-only
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: g/H: repair attempt 2 recorded, detail 'mounted read-only: .loyly/previous-candidate, .loyly/gate-evidence-attempt-1'; 2nd launch saw clean room + both, every file in both not writable; instruction names them

items.name: Three failed attempts fail the cycle, and no fourth builder is launched
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: g/P: every candidate red; builder launched 3 times; failed at gate gate-attempts-exhausted (3 failed attempts)

items.name: Verdicts handed in are filed as given, and the run passes as its cycle passes
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: g/A: file-verdicts & file-score recorded; measurement-filed passes 1 total 2, 01-001 pass 'booked', 01-002 fail 'judged by the main session'; run passed, cycle passed

items.name: An item the verdicts file does not name is Measurement's to record as unreached
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: g/B: only 01-001 handed in; measurement-filed 01-002 fail reason unreached, unreached 1; run passed, 1 of 2

items.name: Verdicts for a run that does not exist are refused
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: g/A: hand-in for R-9 refused no-run; R-9 null

items.name: Verdicts for a run whose gate never passed are refused
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: g/L: run failed gate-attempts-exhausted; hand-in refused gate-not-passed; still failed, 9 effects, no file-verdicts

items.name: A second verdicts file is refused, and no builder follows the verdicts
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: g/C: after score-stage-failed, 2nd hand-in refused verdicts-already-handed-in; no regenerate/repair after verdicts (launches 1->1)

items.name: Verdicts under a grader digest the run did not approve are refused
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: g/A: hand-in with r-2 refused grader-not-approved; R-1 still awaiting-verdicts

items.name: A verdicts file that is blank is refused, and nothing is filed
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: g/A: blank file refused verdicts-not-readable; R-1 awaiting-verdicts, effects unchanged (9), no file-verdicts

items.name: Verdicts Measurement refuses fail the score stage, and the run fails with its cycle
items.rule: The verdicts of the gated candidate are handed in, filed as given, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: g/C: 01-001+09-001; file-verdicts refused unknown-item (measurement); fail-score-stage recorded; failed at score for score-stage-failed; launches 1->1

items.name: A context that stops answering halts the run, and nothing is recorded for that effect
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: g/S: wrapper exits on measurement/derive-checklist; R-1 halted at checklist, context-did-not-respond; effects stamp,pin only

items.name: A run that ended stays as it ended
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: g/D: R-1 failed at fence, R-2 halted at checklist; progress re-read >=5s after each start responded identical (effects, relays, status)

items.name: Reading a run's progress changes nothing
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: g/A: two run-progress readings of R-1 identical; still awaiting-verdicts

items.name: The identity probe is handed the served URL, and passes a candidate that serves the marker
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: g/A: probe argv logged 'argc=1 argv=[http://127.0.0.1:21101]' (probe rejects anything else/bare port); gate attempt 1 gate-attempt-passed; R-1 awaiting-verdicts
